dialect.detail: IBM mainframe batch program, likely running on IBM z/OS or compatible. Uses RECORDING MODE IS F, BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS, COMP-3, DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, and sequence numbers in columns 73-80. Associated with Banco Bradesco S/A (Brazilian bank) CMCD collection system.

purpose.domain_detail: Banco Bradesco S/A - Brazilian bank billing/collections system (CMCD - COBRANCA - CONVIVENCIA E MIGRACAO). Generates a report from table CBCAB009 containing payment media parameters.
purpose.summary: Batch report program that reads a sequential input file (ARCBCA09) containing an image of table CBCAB009 and produces a formatted printed report (RECBCA09) with payment media parameters. It calls POOL7600 for current date/time and CMCD2N0F for processing statistics display.

notable_features: FILE STATUS checking with named condition variables
RECORDING MODE IS F with BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS
CALL to POOL7600 for date/time retrieval
CALL to CMCD2N0F for statistics display
Report formatting with page headers and counters
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars (about 200 lines of 1152 total). All four COBOL divisions are present. The program is clearly a production batch report program from Banco Bradesco's collections system, developed in April 2011 by Henrique Mandrote under analyst Carlos at DEDIC GPTI. Line at 00014700 and 00015200 starts with '-' in column 7 (continuation indicator) but appears to be blank continuation lines used as separators.
